title: VPC & Air-Gap Request Sampling and Priority Buckets
creator: Lena Cho
description: Create a lightweight, sample-driven intake and prioritization mechanism for VPC / on-prem / air-gapped customer requests that balances engineering capacity, regulatory risk, and revenue impact. This ticket defines the sampling strategy, priority bucket definitions, routing rules to Sales/SE/Eng, and the minimum checklist required before a request is escalated to an on‑prem scoping project.
acceptance_criteria: A documented sampling policy that limits deep-scope triage to a statistically representative subset of incoming requests (configurable by quarter)
A clear priority bucket rubric (Tier 0-3) with quantitative thresholds for revenue, compliance urgency, and estimated engineering effort
Routing matrix that maps each bucket to the owner (Solutions Engineering, Platform PM, SRE, Sales Eng) and target response SLA
Minimum network/upgrade/airgap checklist items captured in intake form to avoid immediate rework
Pilot with 3 backlog requests processed through the new flow and retrospective notes recorded
comments: 2025-01-12 - Lena Cho: Kickoff with SE and Sales Ops. Agreed sampling needed to avoid unbounded scoping load. SEs will tag incoming requests with revenue band + customer urgency.

2025-01-20 - Marco Ruiz: Drafted priority buckets. Proposed thresholds: Tier 0 = compliance/regulatory + >$250k ARR; Tier 1 = >$100k ARR or strategic platform partner; Tier 2 = SMB/mid-market exploratory; Tier 3 = research/proof-of-concept. Open to feedback.

2025-01-28 - Security review note from Priya Varma: For Tier 0 we require KMS/HSM requirement flagged and mandatory security preflight. She recommended adding an explicit 'air-gap network diagram' requirement in intake.

2025-02-05 - Engineering feedback (Paul Nguyen): Suggested adding 'upgrade cadence constraint' (windows per year) to the intake so we can surface compatibility risk early. Also flagged that requests restricting outgoing ports will significantly increase effort estimate.
2025-02-14 - Decision: Adopt sampling rate of 30% of Tier 2/3 requests for full triage per quarter, 100% triage for Tier 0/1. Sampling adjustable per-cycle based on backlog and headcount.
2025-02-20 - Ops: Created intake form v1 (link in related_links). SEs to trial on 10 new incoming tickets this week.

2025-02-27 - Pilot retrospective: Sampled 6 Tier 2 requests and 4 Tier 3; found missing fields in 40% of submissions (missing network CIDR and desired RTO). Action: update intake form to make those required.
decision_log: 2025-01-28 - Security: Require air-gap network diagram for Tier 0
2025-02-14 - Sampling rate set to 30% for low-priority tiers
2025-02-14 - Auto-route Tier 0/1 to Solutions Engineering + Platform PM within 48 hours
next_steps: Finalize intake form v2 with required fields (CIDR, upgrade cadence, allowed ports, KMS needs)
Implement routing rules in Zendesk / intake queue to map buckets to owners
Schedule pilot review with 3 customers and collect time-to-triage metrics
Create a simple dashboard showing backlog size, sample rate, and percent of requests with missing info
